name: Concord
tagline: Each group trip gets its own email address and AI assistant that coordinates everyone.
problem: Coordinating times and dropouts makes group trips hard to plan.
solution: A per-trip AI assistant reachable by email or web remembers conversations and tracks dates, budget and participants.
demo_moment: Team-described: email the trip address and see the itinerary update.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of AgentMail API” among 122 submissions.
Works through email, which every participant has.

lessons: Give each shared context its own address.
